narrative: On the board. The foul sheet on the bench in apple-shade, the stone lifted off the first lines and set on the plank. No pen in a hand. On the board. The paper shifted under a thumb at the corner. The inkhorn stays in the knot-hole. No new stroke in the margin. On the board. Two further sheets turned and left open on a blot. The hand does not take the pen from the knot-hole. On the board. Lower on the first sheet again. The moon line is clear. Nothing is struck and nothing is added.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read what was already written, and did not take up the pen.

entities.name: the orchard scene
